description: Queues a draft. The PostKing extension fills it in the user's browser. The user posts it. Queue a reply for a Reddit thread (comment) or a Quora question (answer). Needs the PostKing Chrome extension installed and logged in with this brand selected; it checks for queued drafts about once a minute, opens the thread, and fills the comment/answer box. Nothing is ever submitted automatically: the user reviews the text and clicks Comment/Post themselves. Max 10 drafts per brand per day (11th is refused with a 429). threadUrl: Reddit must be a thread URL like https://www.reddit.com/r/<sub>/comments/<id>/…; Quora must be a question URL like https://www.quora.com/<question-slug> (not a profile, space, topic or /answer/ link). platform must match the URL. body is 1-10,000 characters. humanize (boolean, default false): runs PostKing's anti-slop + humanizer pass on the body before it's stored; the stored text is the cleaned version. Markdown (lists, bold, links, code) is kept; if the pass fails nothing is stored. Free. Returns { draft, humanized } with status 'queued'. Track it with reply_drafts_list (queued → filled once the extension has filled the box, → posted once the extension finds it live on Reddit (done when marked manually), or failed with an error such as 'Thread is archived').

body.description: The reply text (markdown for Reddit), 1-10,000 characters.

humanize.description: Run PostKing's anti-slop + humanizer pass on the body before it's stored. The stored text is the cleaned version.

platform.description: Where the reply goes. Must match threadUrl.

threadUrl.description: Reddit thread URL (/r/<sub>/comments/<id>/…) or Quora question URL.

name: reply_draft_create
